description: Finexio Quality Engine - deterministic CI gate
_comment: This manifest exists so `npx github:booyajones/fqe#<tag>` resolves: npm reads the ROOT manifest when installing from git, and fqe's real one lives in cli/. cli/package.json stays authoritative for the CLI's own version; doc_accuracy.test.js pins this file to match it. private:true because publishing is not intended from here and the bare name `fqe` is not ours to claim on the registry.
